findings: Buys: over the five trading days from the fill, the stocks it bought beat SPY by 0.92% on average (39 buys, 54% of them ahead of SPY; t = 1.7, within noise).
Sells: over the five trading days from the fill, the stocks it sold lagged SPY by 0.77%, so selling avoided that (31 sells; t = 1.3, within noise).
Decision IC: on the 30 days it traded, what it bought ranked against what it sold and left alone by a mean rank IC of 0.030 with the next five days' returns (IC IR 0.22, t = 1.2, within noise).
Holdings IC: the weights it held after each of 43 decision days had a mean rank IC of -0.009 with the next five days' returns (t = -0.3, within noise).
Factor exposures: market 0.75 (t 9.5), size 0.16 (t 3.0), growth -0.08 (t -0.7), momentum 0.10 (t 3.5); together they explain 57% of the daily variation (R²).
Of the +8.0% a year it earned over T-bills (arithmetic mean): market +8.0%, momentum -2.4%, size +0.5%, growth -0.2%; the alpha left is +2.0% a year (t = 0.2, within noise).
Verdict: most of the return is factor exposure (+6.0% a year, market above all); the alpha left is not significant.
P&L: +$9,415 in all, +$9,134 from 37 positions and +$281 of interest on idle cash.
By holding period: 61+ days made the most (+$19,649, 13 positions); 11-20 days the least (-$4,633, 7 positions).
By sector: Health Care made the most (+$9,340, 7 positions); Consumer Discretionary the least (-$3,265, 6 positions).
By stock: CAT made the most (+$4,509, 1 position); AMZN the least (-$2,065, 3 positions).
By market regime of the previous close: risk-on 96 days +0.7% (SPY +2.0%); neutral 18 days +1.1% (SPY +4.5%); uncertain 97 days +6.7% (SPY +4.8%); risk-off 6 days +0.7% (SPY +0.3%).
News: 18 positions opened on news made +$2,107, the other 19 +$7,027; 8 positions closed on news made +$2,565; over the five days from the fill, news-triggered buys beat SPY by 1.22% (t 1.3).

Concentration: the gains are spread out (the best two positions made 36% of them) but winners and losers nearly cancel, so the best two made 93% of the net P&L; the best was CAT bought 2026-01-05 and sold 2026-07-21, +$4,509. Had the best position made nothing, the run would have returned +4.9% instead of +9.4%.
